title: Current walk-code coordinate
statement: For every counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the register vector of $\sigma$ has value $\sigma.\mathrm{cur}$ at coordinate $15$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, the value of the register vector
associated with $\sigma$ at coordinate $15$ is the current walk code $\mathrm{cur}$ of
$\sigma$.
